notes.title: Foxblade current state and future plans.
notes.content:
Hello, first of all, thank you for your support and your patience, there's been A LOT of time since I posted something here, I am making this post to let you know the reasons:
Fisrt, I have been reworking every aspect of the project non stop, new visuals, new models, better systems and adding new sistems and updated interface.
That being said, it has been taking longer than I estimated, as much as I work as fast as I can, my time is limited and the scope of the project have been rising a bit for a solo dev project. 
Still that means that it will take some time for the next update, but it will be HUGE, I have been basically remaking the game, so I just wanted to let you know that the project is still ongoing and will come back stronger. 

Here I will list some new things I've been working on: 
[list][*][/list]New User Interface
I've been designing a new interface and menus to make the more appealing and easy to use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794023/715ce53bad5fb05ab05e01074769b5b2c53b0450.png[/img]

[list][*][/list]Reworking Abilities
I've been changing some abilities and putting new ones for each gameplay style and passive abilities too.
There will be also new abilities that will be aquired via quests and will worth with any playstyle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794023/79ce92540497a51915e193cd911a51d7a3dc27cf.png[/img]

[list][*][/list]New Unnarmed Playstyle
If you don't like to have weapons, I've been implementing a new playstyle to make for 4 different playstyles, this one have some unique abilities.

[list][*][/list]New item slot: Lantern
Light will be important now when you enter caves and places with low or no illumination, this will add a new layer to the gameplay that I will be developing to make it more relevant.

[list][*][/list]New Story in progress
After a lot of iteration, I am developing a more refined story, although my main focus is on the gameplay, I don't want to tell a dull story whatsoever, so I hope you like it too.

[list][*][/list]New models and animations for the player and NPCs.
This is what I think is the big thing, I am remaking all the models from scratch to make the game more appealing, I think this is what have been taking the longer, currently I have some models done but need some paiting, I will share some screenshots with the new models and you can tell me what you think.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794023/3d7aa7acad7b8a3df2952f278d04c6ba36d18c78.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794023/0ed5782a180935ede00b285193e1527684d512bd.png[/img]

[list][*][/list]More weapon variety
I'm also been working on new weapons, like spears, two handed weapons, new type of swords, some with unique animations, also I am working on different animations that may be unlocked depending on the level of the weapon. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794023/91b5369c574e07f7894f905586e849d70dc6e753.png[/img]

[list][*][/list]New Quest System
I am updating the way the quests are aquired and how the dialogues will be shown


Once again special I thanks to all of you who bought the early access, and thank you to those that played the demo and wishlisted the game, thank you for your trust and support on this project. 
I think is at least fair for you to know the current state of the game and how things have been going since the last update.
I cannot thell you when this update will come out, because my time is limited and it is really a lot of work but I hope to get something playable next year, so I will appreciate your patience.

notes.title: Bugfix and Added new stuff
notes.content:
[b]I added some new stuff in this update.[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug when you pick up a quest item, the quest didn't complete until you open the inventory, now it completes when you pick up the item and get the quest completed notification. [/list]
[list]
[*] Updated the demo with a new starting quest which sends you to fight almost at the beginning to add more action from the start. [/list]
[list]
[*] Updated the trees in Quagmire Vale also setting up some things for the next act that I hope will be in the next update. 
Changed the control layout on the pause menu to something more legible and less convoluted. [/list]
[list]
[*] Changed the space bar and now when you press it on a dialogue, it displays the next sentence, and fixed the talk key on guards and moved the Drink Potion shortcut to E for easier access.
Fixed some strange issue that was rendering sharp shadows on a spot on the center of the screen  and the rest were soft, now all are soft shadows. [/list]
[list]
[*] Added a fun sound effect on the teleport spell.[/list]
[list]
[*] Changed the durability color to blue so it is more legible and updated the mana on cloth armor, now it shows that it boost the mana regeneration instead boosting the mana pool like the other types of items.[/list]

[i]I think that's it for now, I will be working on the second act with a new environment with new characters and it's gonna be interesting.[/i]
